location.en: Harbor park, phone call from Ms. Wong

goal.en: Accept the job offer warmly, then confirm the start date and other details.
goal.zh: 熱情地接受錄取，再確認到職日和其他細節。

background: seaside park path with a wooden bench, a takeaway coffee cup on the bench, calm harbor water, tall trees with swaying leaves, late afternoon golden light

intro.en: Friday afternoon. You are walking by the harbor when your phone buzzes. The screen says: Ms. Wong.
intro.zh: 星期五下午，你正在海港邊散步，手機突然震動。螢幕上顯示：王經理。

intro.en: Your heart skips a beat. You sit down on a bench and answer.
intro.zh: 你心跳漏了一拍，在長椅上坐下，接起電話。

lines.en: Hi Kai, it's Ms. Wong from Brightway. Is now a good time to talk?
lines.zh: 嗨，凱，我是 Brightway 的王經理。現在方便講電話嗎？

choices.en: Oh, finally! I almost gave up on you guys, to be honest.
choices.zh: 喔，終於！老實說，我差點就放棄你們了。

lines.en: Well. I'm glad you didn't give up quite yet.
lines.zh: 嗯，很高興你還沒完全放棄。

story.en: Ms. Wong called with good news, and you answered with a complaint. She pauses before she goes on, a little less cheerful.
story.zh: 王經理帶著好消息打來，你卻先抱怨了一句。她停頓了一下才繼續說，語氣沒那麼開心了。

fail.why: 就算等了很久，接到電話時先抱怨會讓對方不舒服。先回答問題並道謝：Yes, now is perfect. Thanks for calling.。

choices.en: Hi Ms. Wong! Yes, now is perfect. Thanks for calling.
choices.zh: 嗨，王經理！現在很方便，謝謝您打來。
choices.tip: 回答「現在方便嗎」說 Now is perfect. 或 Now is a good time.，不要說 I'm convenient。

choices.en: Yes, yes! I'm very convenient now. Please say it.
choices.zh: 方便方便！我現在很方便，請說。

lines.en: You're... convenient? Um, okay. I'll go ahead, then.
lines.zh: 你很……便利？呃，好，那我就說了。

story.en: For a second, Ms. Wong feels like she has called a convenience store. Then she remembers why she called.
story.zh: 有那麼一秒，王經理覺得自己好像打給了便利商店。然後她才想起自己打來的目的。

fail.why: convenient 是形容時間或東西「方便的」，不能用來說人，所以「我現在方便」不說 I'm convenient。要說 Now is a good time. 或 Yes, now is perfect.，「請說」也不用翻成 Please say it.。

lines.en: I have good news. We'd like to offer you the position of sales and marketing assistant.
lines.zh: 我有好消息。我們想錄取你擔任業務行銷助理。

choices.en: Really? Me? I'm not good enough. Maybe you should ask someone else.
choices.zh: 真的嗎？我？我不夠好啦，也許你們該問問別人。

lines.en: Oh. Are you... turning down the offer?
lines.zh: 喔。你是……要拒絕這份工作嗎？

story.en: In Taiwan, this might sound like polite modesty. Ms. Wong takes it at face value and starts thinking about her second choice.
story.zh: 在台灣，這也許只是客氣的謙虛。但王經理照字面理解，開始想起第二人選了。

fail.why: 中文習慣先推辭表示謙虛，但英文會照字面理解成你要拒絕。想接受就直接表達開心：That's wonderful news! I'm thrilled to accept.。

choices.en: Really? I'm so exciting! Yes, I accept, I accept!
choices.zh: 真的嗎？我好興奮！好，我接受，我接受！

lines.en: You're exciting? Well, I suppose you are. So that's a yes?
lines.zh: 你很刺激？嗯，大概吧。所以這是答應了？

story.en: Ms. Wong laughs. Your joy comes through loud and clear, even if your adjective took a wrong turn.
story.zh: 王經理笑了出來。你的開心完全傳達到了，只是形容詞走錯了路。

fail.why: exciting 是「令人興奮的」，形容事物；人感到興奮要用 excited。說 I'm so excited! 或更正式的 I'm thrilled to accept.。

choices.en: That's wonderful news! I'm thrilled to accept.
choices.zh: 真是太好的消息了！我非常樂意接受。
choices.tip: I'm thrilled to accept. 表示非常開心地接受，thrilled 比 happy 更強烈。

lines.en: We're very happy to have you. The salary is 48,000 a year, and the sales course is included.
lines.zh: 很高興你加入我們。年薪四萬八，業務課程也包含在內。

choices.en: That sounds perfect. Could I confirm the start date?
choices.zh: 聽起來太好了。可以確認一下到職日嗎？
choices.tip: Could I confirm...? 是確認細節的客氣說法，到職日、時間、地點都可以用。

choices.en: Great! And the year-end bonus is two months' salary, right?
choices.zh: 太好了！那年終獎金是兩個月對吧？

lines.en: Two months? I'm afraid we don't have that kind of bonus here.
lines.zh: 兩個月？恐怕我們這裡沒有那種獎金。

story.en: You assumed a Taiwan-style year-end bonus. Ms. Wong gently explains that not every country has one.
story.zh: 你以為會有台灣式的年終獎金。王經理溫和地解釋，不是每個國家都有這種制度。

fail.why: 台灣常見的年終獎金，在很多英語系國家並不普遍，不能預設一定有。條件確認完，接著問到職日：Could I confirm the start date?。

choices.en: Great! Do you know a good gym near the office? I need exercise.
choices.zh: 太好了！你知道公司附近有不錯的健身房嗎？我需要運動。

lines.en: A gym? I really don't know. Shall we talk about the start date?
lines.zh: 健身房？我真的不知道。我們要不要先談到職日？

story.en: Ms. Wong called to discuss your contract, not your fitness plan. She has to bring the topic back herself.
story.zh: 王經理打來是要談你的合約，不是你的健身計畫。她只好自己把話題拉回來。

fail.why: 對方在說明錄取條件時，要回應條件並確認細節，不要突然聊私事。可以說 That sounds perfect. Could I confirm the start date?。

lines.en: We were hoping you could start next Monday. Does that work for you?
lines.zh: 我們希望你下週一就能開始上班。這樣可以嗎？

choices.en: Next Monday? That's so soon. Can I start next month instead?
choices.zh: 下週一？太快了吧。我可以改成下個月再開始嗎？

lines.en: Next month? We really need someone sooner than that.
lines.zh: 下個月？我們真的需要人早點到。

story.en: In your last interview, you said you were flexible on the start date. Ms. Wong remembers, even if you don't.
story.zh: 上次面試你才說到職日可以配合。你可能忘了，但王經理記得很清楚。

fail.why: 剛說過到職日可以配合，現在又要拖到下個月，會讓人覺得你說話不算話。可以的話就爽快答應並問細節：Yes, Monday works. What time should I be there?。

choices.en: Yes, no problem. What time I should arrive to the office?
choices.zh: 好，沒問題。我應該幾點到公司？

lines.en: What time you should...? Oh, you mean what time to come in?
lines.zh: 幾點你應該……？喔，你是問幾點進公司？

story.en: Ms. Wong figures it out, but it takes a moment. English questions need their words in a special order.
story.zh: 王經理還是聽懂了，只是多花了點時間。英文問句的字序跟中文不一樣。

fail.why: 英文問句要把助動詞 should 放到主詞前面，而且是 arrive at，不是 arrive to：What time should I arrive at the office?。

choices.en: Yes, Monday works. What time should I be there?
choices.zh: 可以，週一沒問題。我應該幾點到？
choices.tip: What time should I be there? 問清楚時間，是接受工作後最實用的問題之一。

lines.en: Please come at nine. Rachel will email you the contract today.
lines.zh: 請九點到。瑞秋今天會把合約寄給你。

choices.en: Nine? That's a bit early. Could I come at ten on my first day?
choices.zh: 九點？有點早耶。第一天可以十點到嗎？

lines.en: Our day starts at nine, Kai. Including your first one.
lines.zh: 凱，我們九點上班，第一天也一樣。

story.en: The contract hasn't even been sent, and you're already asking to come in late. Ms. Wong makes a mental note.
story.zh: 合約都還沒寄出，你就已經在要求晚到了。王經理默默記在心裡。

fail.why: 上班時間是基本規定，第一天就要求晚到，會給人不認真的印象。可以問要準備什麼：Is there anything I should bring on my first day?。

choices.en: Got it. Is there anything I should bring on my first day?
choices.zh: 了解。第一天有什麼需要帶的嗎？
choices.tip: Is there anything I should...? 主動問準備事項，展現你很認真看待這份工作。

choices.en: Okay! Please teach me a lot and take care of me in the future!
choices.zh: 好的！以後請多多指教，多多照顧！

lines.en: Take care of you? Well, we have a good team. You'll be fine.
lines.zh: 照顧你？嗯，我們團隊很好，你會沒事的。

story.en: Ms. Wong now pictures a lot of babysitting. In English, this sounds like you can't look after yourself.
story.zh: 王經理腦中浮現了當保母的畫面。在英文裡，這句聽起來像你沒辦法照顧自己。

fail.why: 「請多多指教」直譯成 Please teach me a lot 或 take care of me 會很奇怪。英文說 I look forward to working with you.，或問 Is there anything I should bring on my first day?。

lines.en: Just yourself, and maybe a notebook. Welcome to Brightway, Kai!
lines.zh: 人來就好，也可以帶本筆記本。凱，歡迎加入 Brightway！

story.en: You hang up and stare at the harbor for a full minute. Then you call your family in Taiwan. Monday can't come soon enough.
story.zh: 掛上電話後，你盯著海港看了整整一分鐘，然後打給台灣的家人。好想快點到星期一。

notes.explain: 接受錄取時直接表達開心。thrilled 是「非常興奮、開心」，比 happy 更強烈。

example.en: Thank you so much. I'm thrilled to accept the offer.
example.zh: 非常謝謝您，我很樂意接受這份工作。

notes.explain: 確認細節的客氣說法，常用在到職日、時間、地點、合約內容。

example.en: Could I confirm the start date and time?
example.zh: 可以確認一下到職的日期和時間嗎？

notes.explain: -ed 形容人的感受（I'm excited.），-ing 形容讓人有這種感受的事物（This job is exciting.）。同類還有 bored／boring、interested／interesting。

example.en: I'm excited about this job. It's an exciting chance.
example.zh: 我對這份工作很興奮，這是個令人興奮的機會。

notes.en: I'm convenient / Please teach me a lot
notes.explain: 「我現在方便」要說 Now is a good time.；「請多多指教」英文沒有直接對應的說法，說 I look forward to working with you. 就好。

example.en: I look forward to working with you and the team.
example.zh: 期待和您還有團隊一起工作。

notes.explain: 英文裡的推辭會被當真，想要這份工作就直接接受。另外，台灣常見的年終獎金在許多國家並不普遍，不要預設一定會有。

example.en: Yes, I'd love to join the team!
